pay.monthlyDueDays.source: Code on Wages, 2019 (India), section 17: monthly wages to be paid before the expiry of the seventh day of the following month
pay.monthlyDueDays.note: A monthly salary received after the 7th of the next month is late.

pay.monthlyHourlyBasis.source: Workplace policy: hourly equivalent of a monthly salary (26 days x 8 hours)
pay.monthlyHourlyBasis.note: Used only to price overtime for salaried staff whose overtime is paid.

leave.casual.source: Workplace leave policy (default; set by the employer within the applicable Shops and Establishments Act)

leave.sick.source: Workplace leave policy (default; set by the employer within the applicable Shops and Establishments Act)

leave.earned.source: Workplace leave policy (default; set by the employer within the applicable Shops and Establishments Act)

burnout.lateHour.source: Workplace wellbeing policy: check-outs after this hour count as late nights
burnout.lateHour.note: Late nights are counted over 14 days.

burnout.maxLateNights14d.note: More than 3 late nights in 14 days is a burnout signal.

burnout.maxWeekendDays28d.note: Working more than 2 weekly-off days in 28 days is a burnout signal.

burnout.maxDaysWithoutLeave.note: No leave taken for more than 90 days is a burnout signal.

posh.committeeThreshold.source: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013, section 4: every employer with 10 or more employees must constitute an Internal Committee
posh.committeeThreshold.note: Workplaces below this size are served by the district Local Committee.

posh.inquiryDays.source: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013, section 11(4): inquiry to be completed within 90 days
posh.inquiryDays.note: A complaint open longer than this is overdue.

posh.complaintWindowDays.source: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013, section 9(1): complaint within three months of the incident (extendable by a further three months)
posh.complaintWindowDays.note: Late complaints are still accepted; the committee decides on extension.
